# Support

Support is provided on a best-effort basis.

Before asking for help:

1. Read the [README](../README.md), especially Requirements, Troubleshooting,
   and Limitations.
2. If migrating from the upstream package, read the
   [migration guide](../migration_guide.md).
3. Search open and closed issues.
4. Reduce the problem to a small example when possible.

Use the [question form](https://github.com/omar-hanafy/webview_flutter_windows/issues/new?template=question.yml)
for package usage help. Use the [bug report form](https://github.com/omar-hanafy/webview_flutter_windows/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml)
when you can demonstrate incorrect package behavior.

General Flutter questions belong in the
[Flutter community](https://flutter.dev/community). General WebView2 questions
belong in the [WebView2 feedback repository](https://github.com/MicrosoftEdge/WebView2Feedback).

Do not include secrets, cookies, access tokens, private URLs, or personal data
in an issue. Report vulnerabilities privately by following
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
